title: Universal Understanding
text: §3§l§o“At last, I understand the truth that runs through all things!”

Universal Understanding is obtained only by advancing a Guidance Orb through every stage. At its final stage, select Deconstruct All Things above the orb to display the required material, then use a Myriad Codex on it. The codex is not consumed. Mining and replacing preserves the form.

Every use instantly refills mana, without cost, cooldown or external power, and never reduces existing overflow mana. Holding a spell crystal or staff in the main hand also dismantles one held item. Offhand items are not dismantled.

Crystals return ingredients inferred from their current spell: target/shape microcores, elements and modifiers. Ordinary crystals return a Spiritual substrate; high-tier and World Rotation crystals return an Infused substrate. Elements return once, modifiers retain their counts, redundant elements are not compensated, and ink durability is never returned.

Staves return shafts, reinforcements, tips, runes and upgrades with their component data. Parts are not recursively broken into their own recipes. Returns enter the inventory first; overflow drops nearby.
